newsitem.title: USA: Texaco names E&P chief downstream head.
newsitem.headline: Texaco names E&P chief downstream head.

text.p: Texaco Inc said Wednesday its realigned international downstream activities will be based at corprate headquarters and headed by Clarence P. Cazalot, Jr., 45, currently vice president of Texaco Inc. and president of Texaco Exploration and Production Inc.
The company said Cazalot will be named President of Texaco International Marketing and Manufacturing. The unit is composed of the following:
Marketing, to be headed by Eugene Celentano, 58, vice president of Texaco Inc and currently president of Texaco's Latin America/West Africa Division.
Celentano will be named President of Texaco International Marketing;
Manufacturing, which will be led by Wayne N. Clark, 51, now General Manager of Texaco's Pembroke Wales plant; Clark will be named Vice President of Texaco International Manufacturing; and

New Business Development, which will report to John E. Bethancourt, 45, now managing director, business development in Texaco's Middle East/Far East Division. He will be named vice president of Texaco International Business Development.
